variety_description: High yielding, early maturity, medium tall, long slender variety suitable for transplanted and dry seeded cultivation under upland conditions. A short duration and drought tolerant variety developed by BRRI and released in 1993 for planting in Aus season. Popular among farmers in the Barind tract of Bangladesh. Non-sticky cooked rice. Tolerant to major diseases and insect pests. High volume expansion ratio
